facts.business: Birla Corporation Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of cement and jute goods.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Expect cement demand to grow at a CAGR of 6–7% over the coming years.

key_risks: Industry supply overhang and average capacity utilisation around 70%
Persistent pressure on margins despite input-cost inflation
Contingent liabilities related to sales tax subsidy and NTPC fly ash dispute
Electricity tariff changes with time lag in notification
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with struck-off companies include Maharaja Agency Private Limited (receivables ₹0.82 crore, payables ₹0.05 crore), Surface Commercial Private Limited (payables ₹0.01 crore), Mahesh Carriers Private Limited (payables ₹0.01 crore), A and S Advertising Private Limited (payables ₹0.00 crore), Mccoy Automation and Instrumentation Private Limited (payables ₹0.00 crore).
